background: Santander Financial Services plc is the Santander group's bank in Jersey and the Isle of Man, offering deposits and lending to Crown Dependency and international clients, funded by those deposits and the group.
synthesis: The bank is rated A+ on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A-, all three on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026, and the grades rest on the Santander group rather than on the entity's own scale. The site holds no capital or liquidity figures for it, so there is no peer comparison to make. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. A small offshore entity whose grades are borrowed from its parent, so the question for a depositor is Santander's support, which the ratings say is strong.
